mapper.sql: CASE WHEN lr.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PUBLISHING') THEN 'EXTRACTING' WHEN lr.status = 'PENDING_REVIEW' THEN 'PENDING_REVIEW' WHEN COALESCE(cc.claim_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'EXTRACTED' WHEN lr.status = 'FAILED' THEN 'FAILED' WHEN lr.status = 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 'EXTRACTED_NO_CAUSAL' WHEN p.matched_work_id IS NULL OR btrim(p.matched_work_id) = '' OR p.status <> 'PUBLISHED' THEN 'PREREQUISITE_MISSING' ELSE 'NOT_EXTRACTED' END AS causal_status, COALESCE(cc.claim_count, 0)::int AS causal_claim_count

LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::int AS claim_count FROM paper_claim_table pct WHERE p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND pct.paper_id = p.matched_work_id ) cc ON true
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT work_id, claim_count::int AS claim_count FROM unnest( #{claims.workIds, typeHandler=com.paperflow.adapters.persistence.PgVarcharArrayTypeHandler}, #{claims.counts, typeHandler=com.paperflow.adapters.persistence.PgBigintArrayTypeHandler} ) AS u(work_id, claim_count) ) cc ON p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND cc.work_id = p.matched_work_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT r.status FROM v2_causal_run r WHERE r.paper_id = p.paper_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) lr ON true

choose.when: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paper_claim_table pct WHERE pct.paper_id = p.matched_work_id)

mapper.sql: SELECT p.paper_id, p.legacy, p.source_id, os.display_name AS source_name, p.year, p.title, p.authors, p.doi, p.url, p.provider, p.original_name, p.original_path, p.original_type, p.original_size, p.revision, p.version, p.archived, p.matched_work_id, p.latest_parse_id, p.published_parse_id, p.status, , p.updated_at FROM v2_paper_read p LEFT JOIN ${schema}.sources os ON os.id = p.source_id

WHERE p.archived = #{filter.archived}
AND (strpos(lower(p.title), lower(#{filter.q})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(p.paper_id), lower(#{filter.q})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(p.authors), lower(#{filter.q})) > 0 OR strpos(lower(p.doi), lower(#{filter.q})) > 0)
AND p.source_id = #{filter.sourceId} AND p.year >= #{filter.yearFrom} AND p.year <= #{filter.yearTo} AND p.status = #{filter.status}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v2_causal_run r0 WHERE r0.paper_id = p.paper_id AND r0.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PUBLISHING')) AND (SELECT r.status FROM v2_causal_run r WHERE r.paper_id = p.paper_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PUBLISHING')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v2_causal_run r0 WHERE r0.paper_id = p.paper_id AND r0.status = 'PENDING_REVIEW') AND (SELECT r.status FROM v2_causal_run r WHERE r.paper_id = p.paper_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
AND p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND AND COALESCE((SELECT r.status FROM v2_causal_run r WHERE r.paper_id = p.paper_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1), '') NOT IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PUBLISHING', 'PENDING_REVIEW')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v2_causal_run r0 WHERE r0.paper_id = p.paper_id AND r0.status = 'FAILED') AND (SELECT r.status FROM v2_causal_run r WHERE r.paper_id = p.paper_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) = 'FAILED' AND NOT (p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v2_causal_run r0 WHERE r0.paper_id = p.paper_id AND r0.status = 'SUCCEEDED') AND (SELECT r.status FROM v2_causal_run r WHERE r.paper_id = p.paper_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) = 'SUCCEEDED' AND NOT (p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND )
AND (p.matched_work_id IS NULL OR btrim(p.matched_work_id) = '' OR p.status <> 'PUBLISHED') AND NOT (p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND ) AND COALESCE((SELECT r.status FROM v2_causal_run r WHERE r.paper_id = p.paper_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1), '') NOT IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PUBLISHING', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'FAILED', 'SUCCEEDED')
AND p.matched_work_id IS NOT NULL AND btrim(p.matched_work_id) <> '' AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND NOT () AND COALESCE((SELECT r.status FROM v2_causal_run r WHERE r.paper_id = p.paper_id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1), '') NOT IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'PUBLISHING', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'FAILED', 'SUCCEEDED')

WITH page_rows AS ( SELECT p.paper_id, p.legacy, p.source_id, p.year, p.title, p.authors, p.doi, p.url, p.provider, p.original_name, p.original_path, p.original_type, p.original_size, p.revision, p.version, p.archived, p.matched_work_id, p.latest_parse_id, p.published_parse_id, p.status, p.updated_at FROM v2_paper_read p
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.paper_id OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{size} ) SELECT p.paper_id, p.legacy, p.source_id, os.display_name AS source_name, p.year, p.title, p.authors, p.doi, p.url, p.provider, p.original_name, p.original_path, p.original_type, p.original_size, p.revision, p.version, p.archived, p.matched_work_id, p.latest_parse_id, p.published_parse_id, p.status, , p.updated_at FROM page_rows p LEFT JOIN ${schema}.sources os ON os.id = p.source_id
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.paper_id

SELECT p.paper_id, p.legacy, p.source_id, os.display_name AS source_name, p.year, p.title, p.authors, p.doi, p.url, p.provider, p.original_name, p.original_path, p.original_type, p.original_size, p.revision, p.version, p.archived, p.matched_work_id, p.latest_parse_id, p.published_parse_id, p.status, NULL::varchar AS causal_status, 0::int AS causal_claim_count, p.updated_at FROM v2_paper_read p LEFT JOIN ${schema}.sources os ON os.id = p.source_id
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, p.paper_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO v2_paper (paper_id, legacy, source_id, publication_year, title, authors, doi, landing_url, provider, original_name, original_path, original_type, original_size, file_revision) VALUES (#{id}, false, #{data.sourceId}, #{data.year}, #{data.title}, #{data.authors}, #{data.doi}, #{data.url}, #{data.provider}, #{file.name}, #{file.path}, #{file.type}, #{file.size}, 1) ON CONFLICT (paper_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM v2_paper WHERE paper_id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE v2_paper SET source_id = #{data.sourceId}, publication_year = #{data.year}, title = #{data.title}, authors = #{data.authors}, doi = #{data.doi}, landing_url = #{data.url}, provider = #{data.provider}, record_version = record_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE paper_id = #{id}

UPDATE v2_paper SET original_name = #{file.name}, original_path = #{file.path}, original_type = #{file.type}, original_size = #{file.size}, file_revision = file_revision + 1, latest_parse_id = NULL, published_parse_id = NULL, record_version = record_version + 1, updated_at = now() WHERE paper_id = #{id}
